releasePlan.notes: Roles: enable-backend-status-error-rate = killswitch; enable-backend-status-latency = monitoring; enable-backend-status-success-rate = monitoring. This is a net-new surface: control renders no status line, so all three feature-scoped metrics are ONE-ARMED (no control data). No otel* or $ld:telemetry:* autogenerated metrics exist in this project, so global guardrails were unavailable; latency and success are therefore monitoring-only. The sentry-errors-* global metrics were considered and rejected: only the Flask backend initializes Sentry, so the frontend service cannot emit those events. Events are emitted server-side from POST /api/backend-status-outcome, which the v1 page beacons; the frontend has no OTel or LaunchDarkly observability SDK, so span_coverage is none (no observability package was installed, per M10).
